[IDAT.2.3.1] The universal return type: a status a caller branches on, paired
with an optional detail string for a human ([NERR.1.1]). Two words, and the
sizing follows from that -- 16 bytes on 64-bit
platforms; fits in registers under SysV x86-64
(RAX:RDX) and AAPCS64 alike.

`ds_result_t` is declared in `runtime/include/libds.h`.
